verdict.rationale: Mollie documents Advanced access tokens that can be scoped to a specific mode or profile, with permissions grouped by business area and API. Its MCP server docs tie this directly to agent use: an agent token requires the profile.read scope, and optional per-API scopes enable each tool. Separate test API keys and test mode add another way to isolate what an agent can touch. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documented detail on token expiry, rotation and revocation for agent credentials.
